calls.thesis: First explicit Hogue BUY on Alphabet (prior tracked stance was UNCERTAIN): ahead of Wednesday earnings, revenue growth is forecast at 25% with earnings potentially reaching $15/share and revenue hitting ~$0.5 trillion this year, Bank of America sees a possible upside surprise (93% cloud growth and strong TPU sales), and the shares trade at ~20x this year's expected earnings versus ~30x in December. The key market risk he flags is capex guidance (expected ~$200bn this year, ~$300bn next, broadly unchanged).
calls.price_at_call: No share price stated; ~20x this year's expected earnings; analyst average target $430 (~33% upside), low $380 (~17%); his own view is back to about $400 over the next year
